comments:
Celibate householder from the Byang region, chief disciple of Atiśa (ID: 3745) ([Q922IUFM]: 30). 

dGe 'dun grub pa is renowned as his reincarnation and his 'Brom ston-like qualities are described ([BKUHJCNA]: 787-790).

dge bshes ston pa
dge bshes ston pa chen po
'brum ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas
